claims.value: Sołtyk estimates side A’s June Sandomir garrison at 5,000 present under arms.
claims.rationale: Explicit estimate at the June assault preparations; not an opening 26-May muster or the May Austrian garrison. English rendering (ours): "Its strength may be estimated at 5,000 men present under arms."
